CUDA 快速检测器在 GPU 上检测更快，能用笔画像素限定擦除范围。日漫样本中:
The fast CUDA detector runs faster on GPU and identifies stroke pixels to guide erasing. It covered fewer text regions in the Japanese manga sample, so missed text may remain.

The lightweight dual detector runs faster on CPU and covered more text regions in the sample. It uses text boxes and lines, so it can miss strokes on textured backgrounds or in outlined text.

Both detectors use the same background repair process. They mainly differ in what gets erased.

1. 确认有支持 CUDA 的 NVIDIA 显卡及兼容驱动。安装 CUDA 1: 1. Use a CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU with a compatible driver. Install CUDA 12.8 Update 1; select Windows / x86_64 and your Windows version.
2. 安装 cuDNN 9.10.2，选择适用于 CUDA 12 的 Windo: 2. Install cuDNN 9.10.2 for CUDA 12, Windows x86_64. CUDA Toolkit does not include cuDNN; both are required.
3. 将 CUDA 和 cuDNN 中实际存放 DLL 的 bin 目录加入系统: 3. Add the CUDA and cuDNN bin folders containing the DLLs to system PATH. Default installation folders are detected automatically. Custom locations can also use CUDA_PATH and CUDNN_PATH.
4. 完全退出并重新打开 ComiTrans，勾选“使用 GPU”并保存。模型加: 4. Restart ComiTrans, enable GPU, and save. Model logs should say CUDA. A CPU fallback warning means acceleration is inactive. If MSVCP140/VCRUNTIME140 is missing, install the Microsoft runtime below.

同时在途准备、翻译与修补的页数（1–16，默认 4）。数值越大吞吐越高，但更吃显: Pages prepared, translated, and retouched at the same time (1–16, default 4). Higher values improve throughput but use more VRAM and RAM; 2–4 is recommended on 8 GB GPUs.
PDF 页图的分辨率（96–400，默认 200）。越高越清晰，也越慢、越占内存: Resolution of rendered PDF pages (96–400, default 200). Higher is sharper but slower and uses more memory; image inputs are unaffected.
新排版使用的基准字号（8–96，默认 16）。精修页可以逐块调整，这里只改变之后: Base font size for new typesetting (8–96, default 16). Individual blocks can still be adjusted in the editor; this only affects pages generated afterwards.
启用「AI 字体判别」时，每块文本重复判定的次数（1–5，默认 3）。次数越多越: How many times each text block is probed when AI font matching is enabled (1–5, default 3). More samples are more stable but consume more tokens.
并行与字号只影响之后生成的页面；修改 PDF DPI 会让断点续传重新渲染 PD: Parallelism and font size only affect pages generated afterwards. Changing PDF DPI makes resume re-render PDFs.
